newsitem.title: USA: Duramed says no news on estrogens product.
newsitem.headline: Duramed says no news on estrogens product.

text.p: Duramed Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday the company has not received any new information regarding its conjugated estrogens product, which is still currently under active review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
Interest in Duramed's stock escalated Tuesday morning and trading volume has been unusually high, the company said.
Duramed said it has not announced any other news that would account for today's fluctuation.
The company's stock was down 2-1/4 at 9-5/8 in mid afternoon trading Tuesday.

"There is absolutely no change in the status of Duramed's application for conjugated estrogens," said E. Thomas Arington, Duramed Chief Executive. "The company's stock has always been susceptible to rumors. Duramed has adhered to the FDA's 1991 guidance for conjugated estrogens and looks forward to successful completion of this review."
Duramed manufactures and markets a limited line of prescription generic drug products in tablet, capsule and liquid forms to customers throughout the United States.
